metas.name: ★ 9.1 · 2008 · The Dark Knight
metas.description: When a menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman, James Gordon and Harvey Dent must work together to put an end to the madness.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2010 · Inception
metas.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 1999 · Fight Club
metas.description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2006 · The Departed
metas.description: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2019 · Parasite
metas.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2012 · The Dark Knight Rises
metas.description: Bane, an imposing terrorist, attacks Gotham City and disrupts its eight-year-long period of peace. This forces Bruce Wayne to come out of hiding and don the cape and cowl of Batman again.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2001 · Memento
metas.description: A former insurance investigator who now suffers from anterograde amnesia uses notes and tattoos to hunt down his wife's murderer.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1954 · Rear Window
metas.description: A bored photographer recovering from a broken leg passes the time by watching his neighbors and begins to suspect one of them of murder.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2006 · The Lives of Others
metas.description: In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2019 · Joker
metas.description: Arthur Fleck, a party clown and a failed stand-up comedian, leads an impoverished life with his ailing mother. However, when society shuns him and brands him as a freak, he decides to embrace the life of chaos in Gotham City.
